tdd.title: TDD
tdd.body: I write business rules and tests before the implementation. The test is the spec — and the safety net to refactor without fear.

clean.title: Clean Architecture
clean.body: Domain at the core, framework at the edge. Swapping a database, queue or provider shouldn't rewrite business rules.

ddd.title: DDD
ddd.body: Ubiquitous language with the business and well-bounded contexts — especially useful when taking a legacy system apart.

mentoring.title: Mentoring
mentoring.body: I steer tasks and guide developers by explaining the why, not just the how.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.body: ADRs for decisions, READMEs that run on the first try and runbooks for whoever is on call.

securityPage.metaDescription: Headers, nonce-based CSP, form protection, security pipeline and OWASP Top 10 applied to this portfolio.
securityPage.title: How this site defends itself.
securityPage.intro: Full transparency: what is configured, why, and how to verify it. Goal: A+ on securityheaders.com and Mozilla Observatory.
securityPage.cspBody: Every request gets a random 128-bit nonce. Only scripts carrying it run; 'strict-dynamic' extends trust to what they load. No inline script without a nonce, no allow-listed hosts.
securityPage.cspLive: Policy sent with this response (nonce redacted)

honeypot.title: Honeypot
honeypot.body: A field invisible to humans. If it's filled, the request pretends to succeed and is dropped.

rateLimit.title: Rate limit
rateLimit.body: 3 sends every 10 minutes per client, backed by Upstash Redis. The key is a SHA-256 hash of the IP.

zod.title: Server-side validation
zod.body: Zod checks type, length and format. Line breaks in names are blocked (header injection).

turnstile.title: Cloudflare Turnstile
turnstile.body: Frictionless captcha, verified on the server with the secret key.

sanitize.title: Sanitization
sanitize.body: HTML escaped and control characters stripped before building the e-mail.

logs.title: Clean logs
logs.body: No e-mail, IP or message in logs. Provider errors never reach the client.

securityPage.ciBody: Every Pull Request goes through quality, tests and security before merging into the protected main branch. Dependabot keeps dependencies current.
securityPage.disclosureBody: Responsible disclosure is welcome. Contact channels are in security.txt and in the repository's security policy.
